decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and gets only brief mentions, so it is the most likely to fall short of aspirations, but defence and maritime contracts are long-cycle and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on core competences, have their own page and were extended with an LED replacement kit in 2019, which signals satisfactory performance that gives no cause for search.
The relaunched designer task light is a popular, established design close to the core range, and as a lower-volume design item it carries only moderate risk of falling below aspirations.
The pendant office luminaire sits close to the core office lighting business, where LED demand is growing, so it likely meets aspirations in an expanding firm.
The premium pendant luminaire fits the established offer and the firm's growth strategy, and with organisational slack the firm can keep it while premium demand develops.
